title: Appeal to Authority Explained with The Simpsons — Logical Fallacies in TV Shows
skills: recognize appeal-to-authority reasoning in familiar media examples
evaluate whether an authority has relevant expertise and reliable evidence
distinguish legitimate expert support from weak appeals to status or reputation
analyze arguments for logical relevance and adequate support
alignment_note: Uses a familiar television example to illustrate appeal-to-authority reasoning and the importance of evaluating an authority's expertise, relevance, and evidence. Supports logical-fallacy recognition, media literacy, source evaluation, argument analysis, and critical thinking across high school English courses.
